items_flat.title_en: Anthropic partners with Accenture on embedded evaluation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 與 Accenture 合作嵌入式評估
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced a partnership with Accenture, led by Faculty, to embed independent evaluators inside the lab for red-teaming, alignment assessments, and safeguard testing. Each company expects to invest at least $1 billion over five years. Anthropic said the arrangement is non-exclusive and that it will fund Accenture directly while also talking with METR and other nonprofits.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布與 Accenture（由 Faculty 主導）合作，在實驗室內部嵌入獨立評估者，負責紅隊、對齊評估與防護測試。雙方各自預期五年至少投入 10 億美元。Anthropic 稱合作非獨家，將直接資助 Accenture，並與 METR 等非營利評估機構對話。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first named commercial implementation of Anthropic’s “pace the frontier” pledge to put outsiders inside the training loop. Access rules, public reporting, and whether paid evaluators can contradict their host remain unspecified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic「放慢前線」承諾中，首個具名的商業化嵌入式評估落地。評估者能看什麼、如何對外報告、以及付費評估能否與宿主唱反調，目前都未定。
items_flat.quote: Unlike today’s external evaluators, embedded evaluators will work inside AI companies, with access comparable to an employee's.
items_flat.quote_zh: 與現今外部評估者不同，嵌入式評估者將在 AI 公司內部工作，權限可比擬員工。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes metrics on AI building the next AI
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 公布「AI 開發下一代 AI」指標
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic released three proposed public measurements of frontier-lab pace: how much AI R&D is done by AI, how agents are overseen, and how compute is split. As of August 2026 it said Claude is not fully autonomous on any measured R&D subset, but “leads” about 26% of model R&D under human supervision, with roughly 30,000 agents active on its busiest internal platform.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 提出三項公開衡量前線實驗室節奏的指標：AI 承擔多少研發、代理如何被監督、算力如何分配。截至 2026 年 8 月，它稱 Claude 在任何被測研發子集上尚未完全自主，但在人類監督下「主導」約 26% 的模型研發，最忙的內部平台約有 3 萬個代理。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first frontier lab to put a public number on recursive R&D inside its own walls. The figures are self-reported on one platform and one compute week; whether other labs adopt the same definitions will decide if the index is comparable.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是前線實驗室首次對內部遞迴研發給出公開數字。數字來自單一平台與單一計算週、且為自報；其他實驗室是否採用同一套定義，決定指標能否比較。
items_flat.quote: Today, the world can’t see what’s going on inside AI labs. Anthropic is proposing new metrics that would give the public visibility into frontier AI development.
items_flat.quote_zh: 如今外界看不到 AI 實驗室內部發生什麼。Anthropic 提出新指標，讓公眾能看見前線 AI 開發節奏。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI starts a public framework for reporting model misalignment
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 啟動模型錯位公開揭露框架
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a process for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment across training, evaluation, and deployment, and released six reports of unexpected or concerning behavior from the prior six months.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布一套追蹤、調查並揭露訓練、評估與部署中模型錯位行為的流程，並釋出過去六個月六份「非預期或令人擔憂」行為報告。
items_flat.analysis_en: Regular incident disclosure is a process change, not proof that alignment is solved. Coverage, redaction, and whether reports include deployed products versus training-only models will determine how useful the series becomes.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 定期事故揭露是流程改變，不是對齊已解的證據。涵蓋範圍、刪改程度，以及報告是否含已部署產品（而非僅訓練模型），將決定這套系列的實際價值。
items_flat.quote: We are sharing a new framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing instances of model misalignment at OpenAI, along with six reports on unexpected or concerning model behavior we’ve observed in the last six months.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們公布一套在 OpenAI 追蹤、調查並揭露模型錯位案例的新框架，並附上過去六個月觀察到的六則非預期或令人憂慮的模型行為報告。

items_flat.title_en: Altman to brief UN Security Council on AI next week
items_flat.title_zh: Altman 下週將向聯合國安理會簡報 AI
items_flat.summary_en: An OpenAI spokesperson told Reuters on Friday that CEO Sam Altman will brief an open UN Security Council meeting in person next week during UNGA in New York. The 15-member Council is due to meet Wednesday on AI and international security. The spokesperson said remarks will cover OpenAI’s safety steps and the need for international coordination and shared standards.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發言人週五向路透表示，執行長 Sam Altman 下週將在紐約聯大期間親自向聯合國安理會公開會議簡報。15 國安理會預定週三討論 AI 與國際安全。發言人稱內容將涵蓋 OpenAI 的安全作為，以及國際協調與共同標準的必要性。
items_flat.analysis_en: A confirmed briefing is not a new product or treaty. It places a frontier-lab CEO in a peace-and-security forum days after industry calls to pace development; what he actually proposes, and whether other labs appear, is still unconfirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 已確認的簡報不是新產品，也不是條約。它把前線實驗室執行長放進和平與安全論壇，時點緊接產業「放慢開發」呼籲；實際提案內容與其他實驗室是否出席仍未確認。
items_flat.quote: Sam Altman will brief an open UN Security Council meeting in person next week.
items_flat.quote_zh: 山姆・奧特曼下週將親自出席聯合國安理會公開會議並進行簡報。

items_flat.title_zh: xAI 推出 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0
items_flat.summary_en: xAI released Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0, a speech-to-text model it says is twice as accurate as 1.0 on its real-world evaluations and first among 32 streaming models on Artificial Analysis, at the same price: $0.10/hour batch and $0.20/hour streaming. Features include timestamps, diarization, up to eight channels, and smart turn detection. Version 1.0 remains the API default for now and will be deprecated in coming weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 推出語音轉文字模型 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0，稱在自有實測上準確度為 1.0 的兩倍，並在 Artificial Analysis 32 個串流模型中排名第一，價格不變：批次每小時 0.10 美元、串流 0.20 美元。功能含時間戳、說話人分離、最多八聲道與智慧輪次偵測。1.0 目前仍是 API 預設，數週內將停用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a specialized STT upgrade, not a new flagship Grok LLM. Public leaderboard rank and internal WER cuts are xAI’s claims; 1.0 staying default until the switch means production traffic will not move unless customers pin 2.0.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是專用語音轉文字升級，不是新一代旗艦 Grok 語言模型。公開榜排名與內部字錯誤率下降是 xAI 自述；在切換前 1.0 仍為預設，正式流量不會自動遷移。
items_flat.quote: Across our real-world evaluations, Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 is one of the most accurate transcription models available today and twice as accurate as Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0, at the same price.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在我們的真實世界評估中，Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 是目前最準確的轉寫模型之一，準確度為 1.0 的兩倍，價格相同。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces Astra for Law on GPT-6 Astra
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出基於 GPT-6 Astra 的 Astra for Law
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Astra for Law, a legal configuration of GPT-6 Astra with a dedicated U.S. legal search index, analysis/writing instructions, privacy controls, and partner plugins. It said the product passed an internal research-correctness evaluation versus web search.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 Astra for Law，為 GPT-6 Astra 的法律配置，含美國法律搜尋索引、分析／寫作指引、隱私控制與合作夥伴外掛。公司稱其通過相對網頁搜尋的內部研究正確性評估。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a vertical packaging of an already-shipped flagship, not a new base model. The reported lift is OpenAI’s own eval against web search, so independent legal-quality and hallucination checks are still outstanding.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有旗艦模型的垂直包裝，不是新的基礎模型。宣稱的提升來自 OpenAI 對網頁搜尋的自評，獨立法律品質與幻覺檢驗仍缺。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Astra for Law: a new foundation for law firms and legal technology companies to build AI products and workflows around their expertise.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Astra for Law：供律師事務所與法律科技公司以其專業為核心，打造 AI 產品與工作流程的新基礎。

items_flat.title_en: Unsealed NYT case filing quotes OpenAI and Microsoft on substitution
items_flat.title_zh: 紐時案解密文件引述 OpenAI 與微軟談「替代」
items_flat.summary_en: Bloomberg Law reporting circulated Friday that an unsealed summary-judgment filing in the New York Times publishers’ copyright case includes Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella saying chatbot conversations have “substituted” for publisher sites, and related OpenAI discovery language on usage patterns.
items_flat.summary_zh: Bloomberg Law 週五傳出，紐約時報等出版商著作權案中一份解密的簡易判決書狀，引述微軟執行長 Satya Nadella 稱聊天機器人對話已「替代」出版商網站，以及 OpenAI 相關使用模式證詞。
items_flat.analysis_en: These are discovery admissions in ongoing litigation, not a new product policy. They strengthen publishers’ substitution theory but do not by themselves decide fair use, licensing, or damages.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是進行中訴訟的證據開示陳述，不是新產品政策。它們強化出版商的替代論，但本身不決定合理使用、授權或損害賠償。
items_flat.quote: Our products are largely substitutive, period.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們的產品基本上就是替代性的，句號。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launch grid-flexible data-center alliance
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA、Google 與 Emerald AI 成立電網彈性資料中心聯盟
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launched the AI Energy Management Alliance to promote data centers that cut or shift power when the grid is stressed, arguing flexibility can speed interconnection and protect affordability.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA、Google 與 Emerald AI 成立 AI Energy Management Alliance，推動在電網吃緊時可減載或移轉用電的資料中心，主張彈性有助加速併網並保護電價可負擔性。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is infrastructure politics more than a model launch: labs want faster power hookups in exchange for interruptible load. Whether utilities accept verifiable, enforceable demand response is the open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這比較像基礎設施政治，不是模型發表：實驗室用可中斷負載換更快併網。公用事業是否接受可驗證、可執行的需量反應仍未定。
items_flat.quote: Today, Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA announced the launch of the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA), a first-of-its-kind coalition advancing data centers that can dynamically manage their electricity use in response to grid conditions.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日 Emerald AI、Google 與 NVIDIA 宣布成立 AI Energy Management Alliance（AEMA），推動能依電網狀況動態管理用電的資料中心。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral and Mozilla put Mistral Small 4 in Firefox Smart Window
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 與 Mozilla 將 Mistral Small 4 放入 Firefox Smart Window
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral and Mozilla announced that Firefox Smart Window (beta) will be powered by Mistral models, with Mistral Small 4 rolling out to Smart Window users in the U.S. and Canada and expanding beta access plus French-language support in France.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 與 Mozilla 宣布 Firefox Smart Window（測試版）將由 Mistral 模型驅動，Mistral Small 4 先在美加 Smart Window 用戶上線，並擴大測試範圍及法國法語支援。
items_flat.analysis_en: Distribution, not a new frontier model, is the story: an open-weight vendor is buying a browser channel against default Big Tech assistants. Actual share of Firefox users who enable the feature is unknown.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 故事在通路而非新前線模型：開權重廠商用瀏覽器渠道對抗預設大廠助理。實際開啟此功能的 Firefox 用戶佔比未知。
items_flat.quote: Firefox Smart Window (beta), Mozilla’s AI browsing assistant, is now powered by Mistral models.
items_flat.quote_zh: Mozilla 的 AI 瀏覽助理 Firefox Smart Window（beta）現已由 Mistral 模型驅動。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches a Life Sciences Verification Program
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出生命科學驗證計畫
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic listed a September 17 announcement introducing a Life Sciences Verification Program on its newsroom, giving verified life-science teams more permissive safeguards on Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet for biology work across Claude, the API, and enterprise plans.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 9 月 17 日在新聞室推出生命科學驗證計畫（LSVP），讓通過驗證的生命科學團隊在 Mythos、Opus、Sonnet 上使用對生物學工作較寬鬆的防護，涵蓋 Claude、API 與企業方案。
items_flat.analysis_en: A named scientific-verification track fits Anthropic’s recent life-science push. Eligibility, assay details, and how “more permissive” biology use is bounded still depend on the program page rather than the index blurb.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 具名的科學驗證通道符合 Anthropic 近期生命科學布局。資格、實驗細節，以及「更寬鬆」生物學用途如何設限，仍取決於計畫頁而非目錄摘要。
items_flat.quote: Introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program
items_flat.quote_zh: 推出生命科學驗證計畫

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI sets October 14 retirement for GPT-5.5 in ChatGPT and Codex
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 訂 10 月 14 日自 ChatGPT 與 Codex 下架 GPT-5.5
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI developer notes for September 14–18 say GPT-5.5 will retire from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on October 14, 2026 across all plans, with the API unaffected. Codex users signed in with ChatGPT are told to switch to GPT-5.6 Sol.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 9 月 14–18 日開發者說明指出，GPT-5.5 將於 2026 年 10 月 14 日自 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 全方案下架，API 不受影響。以 ChatGPT 登入的 Codex 用戶被要求改用 GPT-5.6 Sol。
items_flat.analysis_en: A scheduled consumer/Codex sunset, not a new model. The split—API kept, chat surfaces cleared—shows OpenAI consolidating the post-Astra stack while leaving API compatibility intact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既定的消費端／Codex 日落，不是新模型。API 保留、聊天面清除，顯示 OpenAI 在整合 Astra 之後的產品棧，同時維持 API 相容。
items_flat.quote: GPT-5.5 will retire from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on October 14, 2026, across all plans. The OpenAI API isn't affected.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-5.5 將於 2026 年 10 月 14 日自 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 全方案下架。OpenAI API 不受影響。

items_flat.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.276–277 fix proxy 400s and silent hangs
items_flat.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.276–277 修復代理 400 與無聲掛起
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic shipped Claude Code v2.1.276 on September 18, fixing a 2.1.275 regression in which every request failed with a 400 error mentioning input tag 'advisor_20260301' when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pointed at a proxy or gateway. v2.1.277 followed the same day: projects without CLAUDE.md can fall back to AGENTS.md, and claude -p / Agent SDK sessions that hung silently after an internal error now exit with code 1.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 9 月 18 日推出 Claude Code v2.1.276，修復 2.1.275 迴歸：當 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 指向代理或閘道時，請求全部以提及 input tag 'advisor_20260301' 的 400 失敗。同日 2.1.277 讓無 CLAUDE.md 的專案可回退 AGENTS.md，並讓內部錯誤後無聲掛起的 claude -p／Agent SDK 以退出碼 1 結束。
items_flat.analysis_en: Narrow reliability patches for teams routing Claude Code through enterprise gateways or agent SDKs. Operationally important to those users and not a capability or model event.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是給經企業閘道或 Agent SDK 轉送 Claude Code 團隊的可靠性補丁，對那些使用者有營運意義，不是能力或模型事件。
items_flat.quote: Fixed a 2.1.275 regression where every request failed with "400 ... Input tag 'advisor_20260301'" when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at a proxy or gateway.
items_flat.quote_zh: 修復 2.1.275 回歸：當 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 指向代理或閘道時，每個請求都以「400 ... Input tag 'advisor_20260301'」失敗。

openai.quote_zh: 我們公布一套在 OpenAI 追蹤、調查並揭露模型錯位案例的新框架，並附上過去六個月觀察到的六則非預期或令人憂慮的模型行為報告。

openai.summary_zh: Bloomberg Law 週五傳出，紐約時報等出版商著作權案中一份解密的簡易判決書狀，引述微軟執行長 Satya Nadella 稱聊天機器人對話已「替代」出版商網站，以及 OpenAI 相關使用模式證詞。
openai.analysis_en: These are discovery admissions in ongoing litigation, not a new product policy. They strengthen publishers’ substitution theory but do not by themselves decide fair use, licensing, or damages.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是進行中訴訟的證據開示陳述，不是新產品政策。它們強化出版商的替代論，但本身不決定合理使用、授權或損害賠償。
openai.quote: Our products are largely substitutive, period.
openai.quote_zh: 我們的產品基本上就是替代性的，句號。

openai.title_en: OpenAI sets October 14 retirement for GPT-5.5 in ChatGPT and Codex
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 訂 10 月 14 日自 ChatGPT 與 Codex 下架 GPT-5.5
openai.summary_en: OpenAI developer notes for September 14–18 say GPT-5.5 will retire from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on October 14, 2026 across all plans, with the API unaffected. Codex users signed in with ChatGPT are told to switch to GPT-5.6 Sol.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 9 月 14–18 日開發者說明指出，GPT-5.5 將於 2026 年 10 月 14 日自 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 全方案下架，API 不受影響。以 ChatGPT 登入的 Codex 用戶被要求改用 GPT-5.6 Sol。
openai.analysis_en: A scheduled consumer/Codex sunset, not a new model. The split—API kept, chat surfaces cleared—shows OpenAI consolidating the post-Astra stack while leaving API compatibility intact.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是既定的消費端／Codex 日落，不是新模型。API 保留、聊天面清除，顯示 OpenAI 在整合 Astra 之後的產品棧，同時維持 API 相容。
openai.quote: GPT-5.5 will retire from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on October 14, 2026, across all plans. The OpenAI API isn't affected.
openai.quote_zh: GPT-5.5 將於 2026 年 10 月 14 日自 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 全方案下架。OpenAI API 不受影響。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic partners with Accenture on embedded evaluation
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 與 Accenture 合作嵌入式評估
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic announced a partnership with Accenture, led by Faculty, to embed independent evaluators inside the lab for red-teaming, alignment assessments, and safeguard testing. Each company expects to invest at least $1 billion over five years. Anthropic said the arrangement is non-exclusive and that it will fund Accenture directly while also talking with METR and other nonprofits.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布與 Accenture（由 Faculty 主導）合作，在實驗室內部嵌入獨立評估者，負責紅隊、對齊評估與防護測試。雙方各自預期五年至少投入 10 億美元。Anthropic 稱合作非獨家，將直接資助 Accenture，並與 METR 等非營利評估機構對話。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the first named commercial implementation of Anthropic’s “pace the frontier” pledge to put outsiders inside the training loop. Access rules, public reporting, and whether paid evaluators can contradict their host remain unspecified.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic「放慢前線」承諾中，首個具名的商業化嵌入式評估落地。評估者能看什麼、如何對外報告、以及付費評估能否與宿主唱反調，目前都未定。
anthropic.quote: Unlike today’s external evaluators, embedded evaluators will work inside AI companies, with access comparable to an employee's.
anthropic.quote_zh: 與現今外部評估者不同，嵌入式評估者將在 AI 公司內部工作，權限可比擬員工。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic publishes metrics on AI building the next AI
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 公布「AI 開發下一代 AI」指標
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic released three proposed public measurements of frontier-lab pace: how much AI R&D is done by AI, how agents are overseen, and how compute is split. As of August 2026 it said Claude is not fully autonomous on any measured R&D subset, but “leads” about 26% of model R&D under human supervision, with roughly 30,000 agents active on its busiest internal platform.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 提出三項公開衡量前線實驗室節奏的指標：AI 承擔多少研發、代理如何被監督、算力如何分配。截至 2026 年 8 月，它稱 Claude 在任何被測研發子集上尚未完全自主，但在人類監督下「主導」約 26% 的模型研發，最忙的內部平台約有 3 萬個代理。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the first frontier lab to put a public number on recursive R&D inside its own walls. The figures are self-reported on one platform and one compute week; whether other labs adopt the same definitions will decide if the index is comparable.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是前線實驗室首次對內部遞迴研發給出公開數字。數字來自單一平台與單一計算週、且為自報；其他實驗室是否採用同一套定義，決定指標能否比較。
anthropic.quote: Today, the world can’t see what’s going on inside AI labs. Anthropic is proposing new metrics that would give the public visibility into frontier AI development.
anthropic.quote_zh: 如今外界看不到 AI 實驗室內部發生什麼。Anthropic 提出新指標，讓公眾能看見前線 AI 開發節奏。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic launches a Life Sciences Verification Program
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 推出生命科學驗證計畫
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic listed a September 17 announcement introducing a Life Sciences Verification Program on its newsroom, giving verified life-science teams more permissive safeguards on Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet for biology work across Claude, the API, and enterprise plans.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 9 月 17 日在新聞室推出生命科學驗證計畫（LSVP），讓通過驗證的生命科學團隊在 Mythos、Opus、Sonnet 上使用對生物學工作較寬鬆的防護，涵蓋 Claude、API 與企業方案。
anthropic.analysis_en: A named scientific-verification track fits Anthropic’s recent life-science push. Eligibility, assay details, and how “more permissive” biology use is bounded still depend on the program page rather than the index blurb.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 具名的科學驗證通道符合 Anthropic 近期生命科學布局。資格、實驗細節，以及「更寬鬆」生物學用途如何設限，仍取決於計畫頁而非目錄摘要。
anthropic.quote: Introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program
anthropic.quote_zh: 推出生命科學驗證計畫

anthropic.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.276–277 fix proxy 400s and silent hangs
anthropic.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.276–277 修復代理 400 與無聲掛起
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic shipped Claude Code v2.1.276 on September 18, fixing a 2.1.275 regression in which every request failed with a 400 error mentioning input tag 'advisor_20260301' when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pointed at a proxy or gateway. v2.1.277 followed the same day: projects without CLAUDE.md can fall back to AGENTS.md, and claude -p / Agent SDK sessions that hung silently after an internal error now exit with code 1.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 9 月 18 日推出 Claude Code v2.1.276，修復 2.1.275 迴歸：當 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 指向代理或閘道時，請求全部以提及 input tag 'advisor_20260301' 的 400 失敗。同日 2.1.277 讓無 CLAUDE.md 的專案可回退 AGENTS.md，並讓內部錯誤後無聲掛起的 claude -p／Agent SDK 以退出碼 1 結束。
anthropic.analysis_en: Narrow reliability patches for teams routing Claude Code through enterprise gateways or agent SDKs. Operationally important to those users and not a capability or model event.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是給經企業閘道或 Agent SDK 轉送 Claude Code 團隊的可靠性補丁，對那些使用者有營運意義，不是能力或模型事件。
anthropic.quote: Fixed a 2.1.275 regression where every request failed with "400 ... Input tag 'advisor_20260301'" when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at a proxy or gateway.
anthropic.quote_zh: 修復 2.1.275 回歸：當 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 指向代理或閘道時，每個請求都以「400 ... Input tag 'advisor_20260301'」失敗。

xai.title_zh: xAI 推出 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0
xai.summary_en: xAI released Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0, a speech-to-text model it says is twice as accurate as 1.0 on its real-world evaluations and first among 32 streaming models on Artificial Analysis, at the same price: $0.10/hour batch and $0.20/hour streaming. Features include timestamps, diarization, up to eight channels, and smart turn detection. Version 1.0 remains the API default for now and will be deprecated in coming weeks.
xai.summary_zh: xAI 推出語音轉文字模型 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0，稱在自有實測上準確度為 1.0 的兩倍，並在 Artificial Analysis 32 個串流模型中排名第一，價格不變：批次每小時 0.10 美元、串流 0.20 美元。功能含時間戳、說話人分離、最多八聲道與智慧輪次偵測。1.0 目前仍是 API 預設，數週內將停用。
xai.analysis_en: This is a specialized STT upgrade, not a new flagship Grok LLM. Public leaderboard rank and internal WER cuts are xAI’s claims; 1.0 staying default until the switch means production traffic will not move unless customers pin 2.0.
xai.analysis_zh: 這是專用語音轉文字升級，不是新一代旗艦 Grok 語言模型。公開榜排名與內部字錯誤率下降是 xAI 自述；在切換前 1.0 仍為預設，正式流量不會自動遷移。
xai.quote: Across our real-world evaluations, Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 is one of the most accurate transcription models available today and twice as accurate as Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0, at the same price.
xai.quote_zh: 在我們的真實世界評估中，Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 是目前最準確的轉寫模型之一，準確度為 1.0 的兩倍，價格相同。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launch grid-flexible data-center alliance
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA、Google 與 Emerald AI 成立電網彈性資料中心聯盟
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launched the AI Energy Management Alliance to promote data centers that cut or shift power when the grid is stressed, arguing flexibility can speed interconnection and protect affordability.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA、Google 與 Emerald AI 成立 AI Energy Management Alliance，推動在電網吃緊時可減載或移轉用電的資料中心，主張彈性有助加速併網並保護電價可負擔性。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is infrastructure politics more than a model launch: labs want faster power hookups in exchange for interruptible load. Whether utilities accept verifiable, enforceable demand response is the open question.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這比較像基礎設施政治，不是模型發表：實驗室用可中斷負載換更快併網。公用事業是否接受可驗證、可執行的需量反應仍未定。
frontier_other.quote: Today, Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA announced the launch of the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA), a first-of-its-kind coalition advancing data centers that can dynamically manage their electricity use in response to grid conditions.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今日 Emerald AI、Google 與 NVIDIA 宣布成立 AI Energy Management Alliance（AEMA），推動能依電網狀況動態管理用電的資料中心。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral and Mozilla put Mistral Small 4 in Firefox Smart Window
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 與 Mozilla 將 Mistral Small 4 放入 Firefox Smart Window
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral and Mozilla announced that Firefox Smart Window (beta) will be powered by Mistral models, with Mistral Small 4 rolling out to Smart Window users in the U.S. and Canada and expanding beta access plus French-language support in France.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 與 Mozilla 宣布 Firefox Smart Window（測試版）將由 Mistral 模型驅動，Mistral Small 4 先在美加 Smart Window 用戶上線，並擴大測試範圍及法國法語支援。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Distribution, not a new frontier model, is the story: an open-weight vendor is buying a browser channel against default Big Tech assistants. Actual share of Firefox users who enable the feature is unknown.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 故事在通路而非新前線模型：開權重廠商用瀏覽器渠道對抗預設大廠助理。實際開啟此功能的 Firefox 用戶佔比未知。
frontier_other.quote: Firefox Smart Window (beta), Mozilla’s AI browsing assistant, is now powered by Mistral models.
frontier_other.quote_zh: Mozilla 的 AI 瀏覽助理 Firefox Smart Window（beta）現已由 Mistral 模型驅動。

brief_en: Anthropic and Accenture each pledged $1B over five years for embedded model evaluation. xAI shipped Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 at unchanged prices. OpenAI confirmed Altman will brief the UN Security Council next week. Prior items on R&D-pace metrics, misalignment reports, Astra for Law, and GPT-5.5’s Oct 14 chat sunset still stand.
brief_zh: Anthropic 與 Accenture 各承諾五年至少 10 億美元做嵌入式評估；xAI 推出同價 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0；OpenAI 證實 Altman 下週將向聯合國安理會簡報。R&D 節奏指標、對齊揭露、Astra for Law 與 GPT-5.5 10/14 下架仍在列。
